title: 伸手
art_direction: After light rain on a safe village path, the same old Taoist kneels to help an adult villager gather several harmless loose herbs and a small wicker basket. Both are fully clothed and their hands are plausible. The villager is unharmed and appreciative; the old Taoist has a gentle attentive expression. Wet stones, soft leaf reflections and warm natural light establish a humble, specific act of care. No medical treatment, suffering, children or fantasy symbols.
